up: List all compounds reported in the document with chembl_id CHEMBL4651341. Return the compound's ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), preferred name (pref_name), max phase (max_phase), molecule type (molecule_type), and canonical SMILES (canonical_smiles). Join the activities table to the docs table to filter by the document, then join to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures. Sort the results by the compound's ChEMBL ID in ascending order.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS chembl_id, md.pref_name AS pref_name, md.max_phase AS max_phase, md.molecule_type AS molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN activities a ON d.doc_id = a.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4651341' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC
